Ashes.effect: -1 Armor at the end of a wave.

Axolotl.effect: Your highest (Max HP) and lowest (Max HP) positive primary stats are swapped when you get this item.

Baby Squid.effect: +1 HP Regeneration when you level up.

Barnacle.effect: +35% stats gained from level upgrades. +1 Curse when you level up.

Black Flag.effect: +1 material when you kill a cursed enemy.

Bone Dice.effect: +50% chance to get +1% Damage when rerolling in the shop. +10% chance to get -1 Max HP when rerolling in the shop.

Builder's Turret.effect: This turret's stats are derived from your best ranged weapon's base stats and scale with Engineering. +1 projectile when you reach 30 Structure Range.

Builder's Turret II.effect: This turret's stats are derived from your best ranged weapon's base stats and scale with Engineering. +1 projectile. +1 projectile when you reach 150 Structure Range.

Builder's Turret III.effect: This turret's stats are derived from your best ranged weapon's base stats and scale with Engineering. +2 projectiles. +1 projectile when you reach 300 Structure Range.

Builder's Turret IV.effect: This turret's stats are derived from your best ranged weapon's base stats and scale with Engineering. +3 projectiles.

Cauldron.effect: +20% Damage for 2 seconds after picking up a consumable.

Crystal.effect: +1% Attack Speed every 1 second until the end of the wave. Bonus is lost when taking damage.

Eyepatch.effect: Projectiles get +1 piercing on critical hit. -10% Accuracy.

Fish Hook.effect: Locked items and weapons have a 20% chance to become cursed when leaving the shop.

Goblet.effect: +15% chance to heal 1 HP when killing an enemy.

Goldfish.effect: Items will be 1 tier higher after the next reroll.

Jerky.effect: Consumables heal you over 4 seconds instead of instantly.

Knot.effect: Weapons can no longer be upgraded or recycled.

Kraken's Eye.effect: You have a 50% chance to explode for 10 (+500% Curse) damage when you get hit.

Lantern.effect: Knocks nearby enemies back every 3 seconds. In Nightmare difficulty, fog visibility increases by 75%.

Lighthouse.effect: -1 Engineering for every 1 Structure you have. In Nightmare difficulty, fog visibility increases by 100%.

Mirror.effect: Duplicates the next item you get from the shop (item limits can't be exceeded).

Pearl.effect: +1% Damage for every permanent 10 Luck you have. +3% chance of finding an extra Pearl in a crate.

Penguin.effect: +1 HP Regeneration until the end of the wave when picking up a consumable while at maximum health.

Saltwater.effect: +10% Speed for 3 seconds when you take damage.

Scarf.effect: +25% Enemy Speed during the next wave.

Seashell.effect: Every ranged weapon's 5th projectile has +3 projectiles.

Sunken Bell.effect: Once per wave, you explode for 100 (+500% Melee Damage +500% Ranged Damage +500% Elemental Damage +500% Engineering) damage when you fall below 40% health.

Treasure Map.effect: +20% chance of finding an extra item in a crate.

Whistle.effect: +50% chance for loot aliens to appear. +20% movement speed for loot aliens. Whistles when a loot alien spawns.
